claims: Continue continuous cardiac and SpO2 monitoring with alarms, given borderline oxygenation (SpO2 91-94% on 2-6 L/min) and dyspnea.
Reassess oxygenation and titrate supplemental oxygen to maintain SpO2 within goal, as SpO2 has drifted to 91%.
Obtain arterial blood gas to further characterize the persistent mild respiratory acidosis (venous pH 7.32, pCO2 65-67) and hypoxemia.
Continue anticoagulation management with serial coagulation monitoring (INR 2.0-2.3, PTT 51-150 sec) on heparin therapy.
Continue thyroid-directed therapy with methimazole and monitor for response.
Recheck electrolytes and magnesium after ongoing potassium, magnesium, and calcium replacement to confirm correction.
Continue enteral medications via PO/NG route and monitor tolerance and swallowing safety.
Perform fall-risk precautions and mobility assessment, given bedfast status and history of slips/falls.
Monitor blood glucose with fingerstick checks and continue glycemic management.
Maintain ICU level of care with continued hemodynamic and neurologic monitoring (RASS -1, GCS 14).
